meta.title: Credit/Debit Note Vendor Acknowledgment: refused for a user without the Vendor role
gaps: Sign in on the specified Enterprise tenant as a user without the Vendor role and attempt to acknowledge or dispute a debit note raised against that user.
Repeat the Credit/Debit Note Vendor Acknowledgment action as a user with the Vendor role and compare availability.
Verify whether the tenant's RBAC configuration deliberately grants the acknowledgment action to additional roles.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in on the specified Enterprise tenant as a user without the Vendor role and attempt to acknowledge or dispute a debit note raised against that user.; Repeat the Credit/Debit Note Vendor Acknowledgment action as a user with the Vendor role and compare availability.; Verify whether the tenant's RBAC configuration deliberately grants the acknowledgment action to additional roles.

args.need: provide access to the specified Enterprise tenant, sign in as both the non-Vendor user and the Vendor user, and test Credit/Debit Note Vendor Acknowledgment for each role

steps.note: The catalog cannot navigate Credit/Debit Notes, perform the acknowledgment or dispute action, or switch between the required user roles.
Record that the tester's resulting screen is usable after the manual permission checks; this does not assert the missing RBAC outcome.
